items.title: Dad fined after son, 2, died in Cyprus hotel fall
items.summary: Joshua Foster "lost control" of his son while showing him the view of a water park from a window.

items.title: Norwegian teenage hitman who flew to UK to commit murder jailed
items.summary: A Norwegian teenager who flew to the UK to carry out murder for an Iran-backed gang has been jailed for 20 years.

items.title: Woman says she was left 'bewildered and confused' by alleged Russell Brand assault
items.summary: The 51-year-old faces three counts of rape, three of sexual assault and one of indecent assault, all of which he denies.

items.title: British man fined for causing death of his two-year-old son in Cyprus
items.summary: A British father has been fined €3,000 (£2,500) for causing the death of his two-year-old son who fell from the fourth floor of a hotel in Cyprus.

items.title: Burnham invites Swinney to work together on 'deeper Scottish devolution'
items.summary: On his first substantive trip to Scotland since becoming PM, he says politicians should focus on solutions "right now" and move beyond the issue of Scottish independence.

items.title: Drugs fuelling 'horrific' events seen in Waterford, says Irish justice minister
items.summary: People who take illegal drugs are "supporting the horrific events we saw in Waterford", Irish justice minister Jim O'Callaghan has said.
